default_in_repayment.text:
a) The Company has not defaulted in repayment of
loans or other borrowings or in the payment of
interest thereon to any lender;
b) The Company is not declared as wilful defaulter by
any bank or financial institution or other lender.
c) In our opinion, and according to the information and
explanations given to us, the term loans have been
applied for the purposes for which they were
obtained.
d) In our opinion and according to the information and
explanation given to us, no funds raised on short
term basis have been used for long -term purpose
by the Company.
e) The company has not taken any funds from any
entity or person on account of or to meet the
obligations of its subsidiaries, associates or joint
ventures;
f) The Company does not have any Subsidiary, Joint
Venture or Associate Company and hence,
reporting under clause 3(ix)(f) of the Order is not
applicable.

fraud.text:
During the course of our examination of the books
and records of the Company, carried out in
accordance with the generally accepted auditing
practices in India, and according to the information
and explanations given us. We have neither come
across any instance of material fraud by the
Company or on the Company by its officers or
employees, noticed or reported during the year, nor
have we been informed of any such case by the
Management.
b) No report under sub-section (12) of section 143 of
the Companies Act has been filed in FormADT-4 as
prescribed under rule 13 of the Companies (Audit
and Auditors) Rules, 2014 with the Central
Government, during the year and upto the date of
this report.
c) According to the information and explanation given
to us, Company has not received any whistle blower
complaints during the year;

statutory_dues.text:
According to the information and explanations given
to us and the records of the Company examined by
us, in our opinion, the Company is generally regular
in depositing the undisputed statutory dues in
respect of Goods and Service Tax, provident fund,
employees' state insurance, income tax, duty of
customs, cess and other statutory dues, as
applicable, with the appropriate authorities.
b) According to the information and explanations given
to us and the records of the Company examined by
us, the particulars of dues of sales-tax including
value added tax, duty of customs and duty of excise
as at March 31, 2025 which have not been
deposited on account of a dispute, are as follows :-
NIL

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹1,743.46 Cr (+66.7% YoY), net profit ₹54.87 Cr (+85.5% YoY).
Maithili Milan Mehta, promoter member, declares no shares held by her are pledged or encumbered as of March 31, 2026.
Aanchal Nirbhay Mehta, member of Precision Wires India Limited’s promoter group, declared no shares held by her were pledged or encumbered as of March 31, 2026.
Milan Mahendra Mehta, Director of Galvawire Agencies Private Limited, declares no shares of Precision Wires India Limited are pledged or encumbered as of March 31, 2026.
On April 6, 2026, Precision Wires India promoter group member Deepak M Mehta HUF submitted a nil encumbrance disclosure under Regulation 31(4) as of March 31, 2026.
Precision Wires commenced commercial production at its copper refining and recycling facility at Zaroli, Gujarat.
